details: Bitcoin and Ethereum experienced a significant market downturn, with BTC falling below $63,000 and ETH dropping under $1,800. This led to over $1.6 billion in liquidations across the market in 24 hours, primarily impacting leveraged long positions. Contributing factors include continued institutional selling and the worst monthly outflows for spot Bitcoin ETFs in May 2026. The market's "Fear & Greed Index" has moved into "Extreme Fear" territory.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Lead Broad Crypto Sell-off, Triggering $1.6B in Liquidations

details: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) announced its first sale of Bitcoin since 2022, a move that has intensified pressure on the crypto market. This action, although a small portion of its total holdings, has raised concerns among investors regarding the sustainability of its bitcoin-backed leverage model, especially as the company's preferred stock fell below $95.
title: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) Sells Bitcoin First Time Since 2022 Amid Market Rout

details: Zcash (ZEC) experienced a sharp decline of over 30% after a security vulnerability was disclosed. The bug, which remained undetected for four years, could have potentially allowed for the unlimited and untraceable minting of counterfeit ZEC tokens. The vulnerability has since been patched.
title: Zcash Plummets Over 30% Following Discovery of Unlimited Minting Vulnerability

details: Hong Kong is advancing its digital asset initiatives by forming an expert group, including major financial institutions like JPMorgan and HSBC, to facilitate and scale the issuance of tokenized bonds. This development signals a strategic move towards integrating blockchain technology into mainstream finance in the region.
title: Hong Kong Forms Expert Group with JPMorgan, HSBC to Scale Tokenized Bonds

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has released its 2026-2030 Strategic Plan draft, which prominently features digital assets as a key priority. The plan outlines an intention to establish a "clear and practical" principles-based regulatory framework, a development that could foster long-term institutional confidence and engagement in the crypto industry.
title: US SEC's Strategic Plan Recognizes Digital Assets, Aims for Clear Regulatory Framework
